intro.text: A private in Duchess Khrissalla's escort on her voyage to Dayside.
A private in Duchess Khrissalla's escort who deserts with Flennid.
An Elisian private in Duchess Khrissalla's escort who deserts with Flennid.

items.text: Torth was chatting with Flennid on deck when Baon told the soldiers to keep their guns out of sight. At Dosha-Har'Ken he guarded the unloaded supplies on the dock, and on the Kerla Flennid told him to keep an eye on the warriors they passed.

At the Diem's tents he showed Daazk a sand master's sash; Daazk fled and Flennid shot him. Sent to help recover the body, Torth instead ran off with Flennid toward the port, taking the tonk that carried the water and food.

appearance.text: Wears a military tricorne, a grey soldier's jacket, khaki trousers and brown calf-high boots.
